title: Substack writers, you need a website
summary: The article argues that Substack writers should build their own independent website to avoid platform dependency risks, maintain full control over their audience and content, and create a more sustainable long-term content business.
problem_solved: Addresses the risk of relying entirely on third-party newsletter platforms like Substack, where writers have limited control over their audience and content distribution.
why_valuable: Provides practical guidance for content creators on diversifying their digital presence and protecting their content business from platform changes or shutdowns.
